name: services/progs/student
description: This is similar to the student_programmes field of the services/users/user method, but allows you to explicitly decide if you want only the active student programmes.
brief_description: Get information on student programmes of a given user.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of student_programme method.

arguments.name: active_only
arguments.description: By default, you will get only student programmes with the status equal to active or graduated_before_diploma. Set this to false if you want to include all student programmes. Please note, that only these student programmes which you have access to will be included. And even if you have access to a student programme, some of its fields may still be hidden (see the student_programme method for details).

arguments.name: old_programs
arguments.description: Get only programs which ended in past

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
